intro.text: A lake near Luthadel, so close to the ashmounts that it holds more ash than water.

description.text: The lake is a sludge of ash, kept navigable by canal workers whose villages sit beside huge heaps of dredged ash, and it is thought to hold few if any fish. Noble estates and resort villages line its northwest and south shores, where some of the black obsidian beaches were covered with sand.
In the Cognitive Realm the lake is more solid than the land around it: a flat surface of smoky stone a few inches high, overgrown with plants whose leaves give off mist.

items.text: Kelsier met Khriss and Nazh on the lake in the Cognitive Realm.
